01 / The Builder engagement

Builder scope & delivery responsibilities

Deliver the agreed Builder scope and a working agent in the NUS HUB full-copy sandbox.

Our mission

Specialised AI & Data experts to kickstart your use-case.

What we do

Salesforce Builder

  • Agree the Builder scope
  • Own the AI & Data build plan
  • Design the Agent Blueprint
  • Build a working agent in the sandbox
  • Hand over & support the move to production
What you own

NUS & delivery partners

  • Project management & delivery
  • Stakeholders & sign-offs
  • Data, content & environments
  • Integrations & non-AI workstreams
  • Rollout, testing & run

Learner Service Agent / Behaviour examples

Explore the learner experience
Learner FAQ Guidance Status-letter guidance; document generation is a separate scope decision.
Answer Questions with Knowledge Candidate standard action: retrieve approved guidance and cite the source.
Status-letter FAQ + approved guide / PDF. Knowledge__kav if HUB uses Salesforce Knowledge; otherwise a validated retrieval path. No academic record required.
Identify the document → use permitted sources → cite evidence → guide to myEduRec. Explain gaps; do not claim to generate the letter.
IN: question + relevant context OUT: grounded answer + citations Validate schema and execution identity.
Correct guidance · source link · missing evidence · generation request · restricted content
Learner FAQ Guidance Shared scope for current-student / alumni transcript guidance.
Answer Questions with Knowledge Clarify first; clarification is conversation logic, not a separate lookup action.
Transcript FAQ + eligibility / exceptions. Approved library; no transcript record query or academic-object write for general guidance.
Clarify learner status + transcript type → retrieve → cite → guide to the portal. Do not claim an application was submitted.
IN: question + clarified context OUT: guidance + citations Self-declared context does not grant access.
Student / alumnus · official / unofficial · ambiguity · exceptions · missing source
NUS HUB Access Guidance Approved sign-in route and access help.
Baseline: approved login link. Optional Flow / Apex: Get Verified Learner Context (illustrative name).
NUS HUB login route + trusted session. Inspect User → Contact / Account mapping, NUS-ID eligibility and content entitlements across all four audiences.
Confirm NUS-ID eligibility and the correct sign-in route for each audience. Never collect passwords. Enforce session and retrieval permissions before restricted answers.
Optional IN: trusted host identity OUT: verified audience / permitted context Exact fields to validate.
All four audiences · guest / authenticated access as agreed · expired session · bypass attempt · restricted citations
Learner Support Routing Unresolved questions → existing NUS service route.
Baseline: Ask a Question link. Optional Flow: Create Learner Service Case (illustrative name; scope to agree).
Routing guide + form link. Optional Case: Subject, Description, verified ContactId. Inspect RecordTypeId, Origin and routing rules.
Explain the gap → offer the route. For a write: review details → obtain confirmation → report success only after execution.
Optional IN: summary + required fields + verified contact OUT: actual Case Id / CaseNumber, or handled error.
Route · cancel · missing fields · failure · duplicate submission. Live transfer and record updates are not committed.
